task: Build the entire demo in the three supplied placeholder files. Make the car clearly read as a car: body, cabin, four wheels, sensible proportions. Make it drivable with WASD and arrow keys using simple arcade-style acceleration, braking/reverse, steering, damping, and visible wheel rotation; add a smooth third-person chase camera. Add restrained lighting, shadows, sky/background and subtle ground/grid cues so motion and scale are readable while the world remains fundamentally a flat plane. Keep the implementation compact, performant, responsive, and usable on desktop. Follow the system-provided full-file block protocol exactly and return the complete final contents of all three files; do not return a diff, prose, or Markdown fences.
